title: Ensuring Healthy Vision in Rural and Elderly Population
summary: Increase access to preventive and corrective eye-care for elderly residents in peri-urban and rural areas.
description:
Saksham Trust, in collaboration with Ramakrishna Mission’s Vivekananda Netralaya, Dehradun, is working to increase access to preventive and corrective eye care for elderly residents in peri-urban and rural areas.

An OPD facility has been established, equipped with advanced diagnostic technologies to ensure precise examinations and timely referrals. This initiative has led to early detection of vision issues, improved treatment adherence, and a reduction in avoidable vision impairment among seniors. By extending community-level access to quality eye care, the program directly advances the goals of the National Programme for Control of Blindness & Visual Impairment (NPCBVI).
